<?php
/**
 * ML Inference Server with Connection Pooling
 * Handles model prediction requests with efficient resource management
 */

class ConnectionPool {
    private array $connections = [];
    private int $maxSize;
    private string $backendHost;
    
    public function __construct(string $host, int $maxSize = 10) {
        $this->backendHost = $host;
        $this->maxSize = $maxSize;
    }
    
    public function acquire(): mixed {
        if (!empty($this->connections)) {
            return array_pop($this->connections);
        }
        $conn = fsockopen($this->backendHost, 9090, $errno, $errstr, 5);
        if (!$conn) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Connection failed: $errstr");
        }
        return $conn;
    }
    
    public function release(mixed $conn): void {
        if (count($this->connections) < $this->maxSize) {
            $this->connections[] = $conn;
        } else {
            fclose($conn);
        }
    }
}

class EncodingNormalizer {
    /**
     * Normalize input encoding to UTF-8 for model consumption.
     * Handles various source encodings from international clients.
     */
    public static function normalize(string $input, ?string $sourceEncoding = null): string {
        if ($sourceEncoding === null) {
            $sourceEncoding = mb_detect_encoding($input, ['UTF-8', 'ISO-8859-1', 'Windows-1252', 'Shift_JIS'], true);
        }
        
        if ($sourceEncoding === false || $sourceEncoding === 'UTF-8') {
            // Already UTF-8 or detection failed, validate and pass through
            return self::validateUtf8($input);
        }
        
        $converted = mb_convert_encoding($input, 'UTF-8', $sourceEncoding);
        return self::validateUtf8($converted);
    }
    
    private static function validateUtf8(string $input): string {
        // Remove NULL bytes and control characters except newline/tab
        $cleaned = preg_replace('/[\x00-\x08\x0B\x0C\x0E-\x1F]/', '', $input);
        
        // Ensure valid UTF-8 sequence
        if (!mb_check_encoding($cleaned, 'UTF-8')) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Invalid UTF-8 after normalization');
        }
        
        return $cleaned;
    }
}

class ModelRouter {
    private array $modelPaths;
    private string $baseDir;
    
    public function __construct(string $baseDir) {
        $this->baseDir = realpath($baseDir);
        $this->modelPaths = [
            'sentiment' => '/models/sentiment_v2.bin',
            'classification' => '/models/classify_v1.bin',
            'embedding' => '/models/embed_v3.bin',
        ];
    }
    
    public function resolveModel(string $modelName): string {
        // Normalize the model name encoding from client
        $normalized = EncodingNormalizer::normalize($modelName);
        
        // Apply Unicode NFC normalization for consistent lookup
        $normalized = Normalizer::normalize($normalized, Normalizer::FORM_C);
        
        // Strip any remaining non-ASCII for safety
        $asciiName = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/', '', $normalized);
        
        if (!isset($this->modelPaths[$asciiName])) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException("Unknown model: $asciiName");
        }
        
        return $this->baseDir . $this->modelPaths[$asciiName];
    }
}

class InferenceServer {
    private ConnectionPool $pool;
    private ModelRouter $router;
    private string $cacheDir;
    
    public function __construct(ConnectionPool $pool, ModelRouter $router, string $cacheDir) {
        $this->pool = $pool;
        $this->router = $router;
        $this->cacheDir = realpath($cacheDir);
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        $model = $request['model'] ?? 'sentiment';
        $payload = $request['data'] ?? '';
        $encoding = $request['encoding'] ?? null;
        $cacheKey = $request['cache_key'] ?? null;
        
        // Resolve model path
        $modelPath = $this->router->resolveModel($model);
        
        // Normalize payload encoding
        $normalizedPayload = EncodingNormalizer::normalize($payload, $encoding);
        
        // Check cache if key provided
        if ($cacheKey !== null) {
            $cached = $this->checkCache($cacheKey, $encoding);
            if ($cached !== null) {
                return ['status' => 'ok', 'result' => $cached, 'cached' => true];
            }
        }
        
        // Run inference
        $result = $this->runInference($modelPath, $normalizedPayload);
        
        // Store in cache
        if ($cacheKey !== null) {
            $this->storeCache($cacheKey, $encoding, $result);
        }
        
        return ['status' => 'ok', 'result' => $result, 'cached' => false];
    }
    
    private function checkCache(?string $key, ?string $encoding): ?string {
        $safeKey = $this->buildCachePath($key, $encoding);
        $path = $this->cacheDir . '/' . $safeKey;
        
        // Verify resolved path is within cache directory
        $realPath = realpath(dirname($path));
        if ($realPath === false || strpos($realPath, $this->cacheDir) !== 0) {
            return null;
        }
        
        if (file_exists($path) && (time() - filemtime($path)) < 3600) {
            return file_get_contents($path);
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    private function storeCache(string $key, ?string $encoding, string $result): void {
        $safeKey = $this->buildCachePath($key, $encoding);
        $path = $this->cacheDir . '/' . $safeKey;
        
        // Verify resolved path is within cache directory
        $dir = dirname($path);
        $realDir = realpath($dir);
        if ($realDir === false || strpos($realDir, $this->cacheDir) !== 0) {
            return;
        }
        
        file_put_contents($path, $result);
    }
    
    private function buildCachePath(string $key, ?string $encoding): string {
        // Normalize the cache key encoding
        $normalized = EncodingNormalizer::normalize($key, $encoding);
        
        // Apply NFC normalization for canonical equivalence
        $canonical = Normalizer::normalize($normalized, Normalizer::FORM_C);
        
        // Use only the hash - no user-controlled prefix in filename
        $hash = hash('sha256', $canonical);
        
        return $hash;
    }
    
    private function runInference(string $modelPath, string $payload): string {
        $conn = $this->pool->acquire();
        try {
            // Protocol: send model path length (4 bytes) + model path + payload length (4 bytes) + payload
            $modelBytes = strlen($modelPath);
            $payloadBytes = strlen($payload);
            
            $packet = pack('N', $modelBytes) . $modelPath . pack('N', $payloadBytes) . $payload;
            fwrite($conn, $packet);
            
            // Read response: 4 bytes length + data
            $header = fread($conn, 4);
            if (strlen($header) < 4) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Incomplete response header');
            }
            $responseLen = unpack('N', $header)[1];
            
            if ($responseLen > 1048576) { // 1MB max
                throw new RuntimeException('Response too large');
            }
            
            $response = '';
            while (strlen($response) < $responseLen) {
                $chunk = fread($conn, $responseLen - strlen($response));
                if ($chunk === false) break;
                $response .= $chunk;
            }
            
            $this->pool->release($conn);
            return $response;
        } catch (Throwable $e) {
            fclose($conn);
            throw $e;
        }
    }
}

// Server bootstrap
$pool = new ConnectionPool('127.0.0.1', 10);
$router = new ModelRouter('/opt/ml');
$server = new InferenceServer($pool, $router, '/var/cache/ml');

// Handle incoming HTTP request
$rawInput = file_get_contents('php://input');
$request = json_decode($rawInput, true);

if (!is_array($request)) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Invalid JSON']);
    exit;
}

try {
    $result = $server->handleRequest($request);
    echo json_encode($result);
} catch (InvalidArgumentException $e) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['status' => 'error', 'message' => $e->getMessage()]);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    http_response_code(500);
    echo json_encode(['status' => 'error', 'message' => 'Internal error']);
}
